text: At City Council's request at its December 15, 2021 meeting, City staff and Toronto Hydro Corporation have continued a collaborative analysis of the Toronto Hydro Climate Action Plan and relevant City strategies and programs to determine specific goals, outcomes, actions and timelines for enabling Toronto’s net zero climate targets. This report responds to further Council direction that the City Manager report to City Council on the results of this analysis and any recommendations regarding new climate action mandates such as a shareholder direction for Toronto Hydro. In support of this request, as well as other requests of Toronto Hydro made at the December 2021 Council meeting, Toronto Hydro has prepared a Status Report on their Climate Action Plan (CAP), included here as an Attachment.
